requirements.text: Require exactly one ontology header and bind optional version IRI/import declarations to that header.
Resolve every owl:imports IRI only to one checksum-bound local ontology or version-IRI alias before reasoner invocation.
Emit deterministic evidence of the ontology/version identities and import edges OWLAPI actually loaded.
Run OWL2DLProfile over the complete merged ontology and record bounded profile evidence in the qualification artifact.
Bind the reasoner report and immutable snapshot to the exact profile/import qualification SHA-256 and verify it independently in Rust.
Fail closed on missing, mismatched, incomplete, unresolved, duplicate, or profile-invalid qualification evidence.
Provide strict schema, fixtures, Java/Rust regression tests, documentation, inheritance evidence and cumulative gates without overclaiming Phase 40.6+.
